title: Sodium acid pyrophosphate, sodium pyrophosphate, tetra sodium pyrophosphate and calcium pyrophosphate, 21 CFR 182.1087, 182.6787, 182.6789 and 182.8223: substances generally recognized as safe
journal: Code of Federal Regulations, title 21, part 182, subparts B (Multiple Purpose GRAS Food Substances), G (Sequestrants) and I (Nutrients), read in the electronic Code of Federal Regulations, up to date as of 20 October 2026
funder: US Food and Drug Administration; the text is federal regulation codified by the Office of the Federal Register.
result: Section 182.1087 (subpart B, multiple purpose GRAS food substances) lists sodium acid pyrophosphate; sections 182.6787 and 182.6789 (subpart G, sequestrants) list sodium pyrophosphate and tetra sodium pyrophosphate; section 182.8223 (subpart I, nutrients) lists calcium pyrophosphate. Each states: 'This substance is generally recognized as safe when used in accordance with good manufacturing practice.'
